# aj tui

## `aj tui`

Browse, search and change issues in a full-screen terminal UI.

Type a query with completion as you go (Tab), read issues beside the list, and
move, assign, comment, relabel or create without leaving it. ? shows every key.

```text
aj tui [QUERY] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
aj tui
aj tui '@me is:open sort:-priority'
aj tui --view "Current sprint"
aj -n tui                       # try it all; nothing is sent
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` |  | A smart query or JQL to start with (default: your open work). |
| `-v`, `--view` `TEXT` |  | Start with a saved view, by name. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
